name: RoC Retinol Correxion Night Serum Capsules
facts: Single-dose retinol capsules
Retinoids are among the most studied ingredients for the look of fine lines
Use at night, start slowly, and wear SPF by day
skip: Pregnant or breastfeeding? Skip retinol and ask your doctor.

name: Drunk Elephant C-Firma Fresh Day Serum
hook: Why is this vitamin C sold as a powder?
facts: 15% L-ascorbic acid with vitamin E and ferulic acid
The vitamin C stays a powder until you mix it
Brand says ~95% of the vitamin C remains a year after mixing
skip: Reactive skin? Patch-test before using it on your face.

name: SkinCeuticals C E Ferulic
hook: The vitamin C serum with a study behind it
facts: 15% L-ascorbic acid, 1% vitamin E, 0.5% ferulic acid
That combination roughly doubled UV protection in a 2005 study
We link to the brand's own site, with no commission
skip: Sensitive skin? Patch-test first; mild tingling is common.

name: Paula's Choice C15 Super Booster
facts: 15% vitamin C at a listed pH of 3.0
Plus vitamin E, ferulic acid and peptides
Use alone or mix into your moisturizer
skip: Sensitive skin? Patch-test and start every other day.

name: The Ordinary Vitamin C Suspension 23% + HA Spheres 2%
facts: 23% L-ascorbic acid in a water-free base
In the classic study, absorption peaked at 20%
The brand says a slight tingle may occur
skip: Sensitive or dry skin? Start with a gentler formula.

name: Klairs Freshly Juiced Vitamin Drop
hook: A gentler way to start vitamin C
facts: Marketed for sensitive skin
Can be mixed into your usual serum or lotion
Brand advice: no AHA or BHA in the same routine

name: NuFACE Trinity
facts: A gentle current passed over a conductive gel
About 5 minutes a session, 5 days a week for 60 days, then 2–3 times weekly
Brand: FDA-cleared for facial stimulation, cosmetic use
skip: Pregnant, pacemaker or implanted device, epilepsy, active cancer: don't use it (per the manual).

name: Dr. Dennis Gross SpectraLite FaceWare Pro
hook: 3 minutes, hands-free. Is an LED mask worth it?
facts: Red, blue, or both light modes
3-minute sessions with auto shut-off
Red light evidence: promising, but modest
skip: On light-sensitizing medication or have an eye condition? Ask your doctor first.

name: HigherDOSE Infrared Sauna Blanket
hook: The premium sauna blanket: what you're paying for
facts: 9 heat levels, listed up to ~176°F
Published third-party EMF testing
120-day guarantee when bought direct; Amazon orders follow the listing
skip: Pregnant, heart condition, heat sensitivity or implanted device? Talk to your doctor first.

name: LifePro RejuvaWrap Infrared Sauna Blanket
facts: Same 9 heat levels, listed 95–176°F
Towel, thermal wraps and carry bag in the box
The budget ($) pick in our comparison
skip: Pregnant, heart condition, heat sensitivity or implanted device? Talk to your doctor first.

name: SereneLife Full-Size Portable Infrared Sauna
facts: Sit upright inside; on most tents your head stays out
Listed up to 140°F from 3 carbon panels
Needs about a 3×3-foot footprint
skip: Pregnant, heart condition or heat sensitivity? Talk to your doctor first.

name: Ice Barrel 300
hook: A cold plunge with no chiller and no plumbing
facts: Fill it with water and ice
Limited lifetime warranty on the tub, per the brand
Test the habit before a pricier chiller setup
skip: Heart condition, high blood pressure or pregnant? Ask your doctor. Never plunge alone.

name: Dr Teal's Epsom Salt Magnesium Soak
facts: A classic Epsom salt soak
A budget staple for a long, warm bath
Follow the label's cautions
skip: Open wounds or a skin condition? Check with your doctor first.

name: L'Occitane Almond Shower Oil
hook: The shower oil that turns to milk
facts: An oil that turns milky with water
A long-standing prestige bath staple
Rinse well: oils can make floors slippery
skip: Nut allergy? Check the ingredients first.

name: ASAKUKI 500ml Essential Oil Diffuser
hook: Scent as the last step of the ritual
facts: A 500 ml ultrasonic diffuser
Cool mist, not heat
Clean it regularly, per the manual
skip: Pets at home? Some essential oils are unsafe for cats and dogs. Ask your vet.

name: Plant Therapy Top 6 Organic Singles Set
hook: Six essential oils to start with
facts: A set of six organic single oils
Batch-tested, per the brand
Dilute before any use on skin
skip: Pregnant, or kids or pets at home? Ask your doctor or vet first.

name: Hatch Restore 2
hook: Wake up to light, not an alarm
facts: Sunrise light, sleep sounds and wind-down routines
Core features work without the optional subscription
Built for routine and relaxation, not as a sleep treatment
skip: Ongoing sleep trouble? Talk to a doctor.

name: Bearaby Cotton Napper Weighted Blanket
hook: A weighted blanket with no beads
facts: Hand-knit organic cotton
An open knit, made for hot sleepers
Designed for calm, comforting pressure
skip: Not for babies or young children. Pick a weight you can easily lift off.
